featured_reviews.name: Guru Gym Foodie
featured_reviews.review_text: 10 pin Bowling in TimeZone. On Thursdays there is a waiting line of 200 people. Waiting time varies from 2 hours to 5 hours. After 4 pm the rate on Thursdays is just Rs.99. But it is amazing how Irshad and Shahid manage the crowd so well. The others too keep the crowd disciplined. In fact I scored 168 today based on the demo given by Irshad. Amazing how Sky City Mall has become so popular and so crowded. I thank all the staff for their excellent service.

featured_reviews.name: Arshad Ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an awesome time at Timezone Sky City! The bowling alley was fantastic—clean, fun, and really well-maintained. The atmosphere was energetic and perfect for a great day out.

A special shout-out to Irsad, who provided exceptional service. He was friendly, helpful, and made the experience even better with his professionalism and positive attitude. Staff like him truly make a difference!

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for fun activities and great customer service.

If you want it shorter, more formal, or more enthusiastic, just let me know!🤩💯

featured_reviews.name: Om Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very worst experience with the staff and technician team. There was an issue with the game, and when I asked the staff for help, the first response I got was, “Inform the technician, not me.” Amazing customer service standards.

Even after I personally found the technician and explained the issue properly, he barely looked into it. We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.

featured_reviews.review_text: Deepti and Vidhi from Timezone, Sky City Mall, Borivali were absolutely fantastic hosts. Both were energetic, engaging, and handled the party with great dedication. Their enthusiasm truly made the experience memorable.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated our son’s birthday at Skycity Mall Play and Learn, and overall, it was a really good experience. The staff was professional, the place is spacious (especially considering Mumbai standards), and everything was clean and well-maintained. Special thanks to Zainab for organizing the party so well , her support made the event smooth and enjoyable.

That said, there are a few areas where the experience can be improved:
1.	Seating Arrangements:
Proper seating inside the party hall would make the event more comfortable for parents and guests.
2.	Gift Management:
A designated cage trolley or secure storage for gifts would help, as the gifts took up a lot of space and needed better handling.
3.	Party Area Access Control:
Even though the party area was separate, non-invitee kids occasionally walked in and started eating food. Better monitoring or access control would ensure the arrangements are used only by invited guests.
4.	Host Involvement:
The party host could spend more time actively overseeing the flow of the event helping with coordination, ensuring things run smoothly, and paying attention to guest needs.
5.	Food Quality:
The food presentation was good, but the taste was average. With the premium pricing, slightly better quality would be appreciated.

I’m sharing this feedback because the charges are on the higher side, so a bit more discipline and attention to detail would
elevate the experience further.

On the positive side, the place is absolutely fun for kids , so much so that they were tired enough to almost skip school the next day! Overall, we had a memorable celebration and hope to see these improvements implemented.

Had a really great experience at Next Level - The Gaming Cafe. The setup is super clean and well-maintained, and the gaming PCs/consoles run smoothly without any lag issues. The ambience is perfect for long gaming sessions — comfortable seating, good lighting, and a nice vibe overall.

What stood out the most was the staff. They’re friendly, helpful, and make sure everyone is comfortable. The game collection is also impressive, whether you’re into FIFA, Valorant, or casual multiplayer games with friends. Cold drinks and snacks were actually pretty good for a gaming café.

Overall, it’s a solid spot to chill with friends, unwind after college/work, or even spend hours gaming competitively. Definitely one of the better gaming cafés in Vile Parle. Would love to visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Srinand
featured_reviews.review_text: I may be biased because I spend a lot of time here, but LSG LAN Center is truly one of the very best PC gaming centers I have ever visited. It's well air-conditioned, very clean and has cool RGB lighting around the place. The prices are extremely affordable to say the least and the PCs are amazing. Paying 60₹ an hour for a gaming PC which gets over 400 FPS on the most popular games like Valorant is just a bargain any way you see it. The owner is friendly and it just takes about 30 seconds to log in once you have registered your account there. The mall in which this is located might be a little shady but trust me, you won't regret going there. I only wish it wasn't closed on Mondays :(. Highly recommended.
